site_name: St Marys Convent And Nursing Home
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - Detailed construction drawings showing the connection of the roof of the extension hereby approved and the existing hipped roof of the sitting room building shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, the carport shall be relocated south so that the supporting posts of the southern side of the structure are positioned to be aligned with the centre of the existing brick pier on the southern side of the adjacent entry gate. Detailed drawings of the carport shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.
description: Erection of single storey bed sitting room, erection of new car port structure and installation of a new gate to the boundary wall. (Old Chiswick Conservation Area).
